findings.passage: The speed at which SJR 10 advanced while legislation aimed at expanding dignity and justice remains stalled is troubling.
findings.note: Quoted statement in a Black caucus press release. In the same statement he describes SJR 10 as the measure that would require voters to provide photo identification while voting in person and will appear on the November ballot. He calls the speed at which it advanced troubling next to a stalled bill on a different subject.

findings.passage: Any law that makes it harder for eligible citizens to vote is wrong.
findings.note: Statement in a House news release on HCR 5, a resolution urging Congress not to pass HR 1 (For the People Act). General statement about laws that make voting harder; no ID or citizenship rule named.
